blurb: Studio Yoga Glow offers a variety of yoga classes including Viniyoga, Vinyasa, Hatha Flow, Hatha, Yoga Doux, Yoga Sur Chaise, Yin Yoga, Yoga Restaurateur, and community classes. Classes are adapted to all levels and physical conditions, with an emphasis on accessibility and holistic well-being. The studio is located in Lachute and provides a welcoming environment for all practitioners.
extraNote: Purchase a package on the pricing page and then register for classes · Yoga room is slightly heated during hot yoga classes
